pages.image_type: annotated color photograph (lunar surface with magnified insets)
pages.description: A photograph of a barren, gray lunar-like surface fills the lower portion of the frame beneath a dark, nearly black sky. The regolith is cratered and strewn with small rocks, sloping gently toward a bright, flat horizon. Reticle cross-marks (fiducial crosses) are distributed across the scene. In the lower right, the elongated dark shadow of a standing human figure (appearing to wear a helmet or headgear) is cast across the ground. The top of the composite contains two yellow-outlined magnification boxes labeled 'Area 1' and 'Area 2', each connected by yellow lines to small corresponding boxes near the horizon in the sky region. Area 1 shows a plain dark field, while Area 2 shows a dark field with a few faint bluish specks or dots. The overall image has a dark teal/green cast.

observations.claim: The image includes two yellow-bordered inset boxes labeled 'Area 1' and 'Area 2'
A dark humanoid shadow is cast across the ground in the lower right
The ground surface is gray, cratered, and rocky resembling lunar regolith
Reticle cross marks are visible across the terrain
The Area 2 magnified inset contains faint bluish dots against a dark background
The sky above the horizon is dark and nearly featureless
The overall photograph has a teal/green color cast
